maria: opened PR to update Nebula3b model card: clarify 'effective long-window', add SDK3 batch-helper example, and note quantized fallback. PTAL.
jin: quick skim. looks good. tiny: add `import numpy as np` in the shard example and use `max_new_tokens` in generate.
ryan: also mark bench table rows with variant tags (nebula3b-fp16 / nebula3b-q4) so readers know which numbers map to which build.
maria: good catches. i'll add the import and variant tags. i'll also add a one-liner recommending the batch helper before manual sharding.
docs-bot: preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-6077
infra-bot: created redirect for old bench csv -> /bench/nebula3b/bench_v2.csv (id 1133)
maria: thanks — will push edits and merge once CI is green. will ping eng-ml on the roll-forward note for a quick compatibility check.
